author: adjaliya
title: According to researchers with Rapid7, over 110,000 devices appear on internet, which run stable Samba versions, while 92,500 seem to run unstable Samba versions, for which there is no fix. The newest Samba models, including the models 4.6.x before 4.6.4, 4.5.x before 4.5.10 and 3.5.0 before 4.4.13, was impacted by this error. May 24, 2017, Samba released version 4.6.4, which fixes a serious remote code execution vulnerability, vulnerability number CVE-2017-7494, which affected Samba 3.5.0 onwards.  Vulnerability number: CVE-2017-7494 Severity Rating: High Affected software:     • Samba Version < 4.6.4     • Samba Version < 4.5.10     • Samba Version < 4.4.14  Unaffected software:     • Samba Version = 4.6.4     • Samba Version = 4.5.10     • Samba Version = 4.4.14
